summary.verdict: ARCHITECTURALLY FRAGMENTED WITH CRITICAL EVIDENCE AND PATH DEFECTS
summary.core_insight: AstraRun is currently a deterministic hybrid Windows resident command bar (v0.10 UIA + regex + hardcoded fallback templates). The advertised multi-model cognitive spine (Spark, Qwen, Laya, RAG, OmniParser) exists primarily in isolated test harnesses, while the production resident executable runs with these subsystems completely unwired or simulated.

findings.title: CWD-dependent runtime storage causes frozen application startup crash
findings.description: Production code resolved SQLite databases, log directories, and config paths relative to process CWD. When launched from C:\Windows\System32 or arbitrary non-writable directories, MachineModel threw WinError 5 Access is denied: 'C:\Windows\System32\data'. In total, 44 relative path constructions existed across 20 production files.
findings.remediation: Implemented centralized AstraPaths in src/astrarun/core/paths.py resolving strictly against %LOCALAPPDATA%\AstraRun and %TEMP%\AstraRun. Verified across 6 distinct CWDs.

findings.title: Simulated ChatGPT Web delegation fabricated and mislabeled as REAL_INSTALLED_PRODUCT_EXECUTION
findings.description: ChatGPTWebDelegate in src/astrarun/delegation/chatgpt_web.py only checked psutil for chrome/msedge/brave process existence. Its _dispatch_browser_interaction() method returned a 100% hardcoded Python script for projectile motion and hardcoded review approval strings. It never launched a browser, never navigated to chatgpt.com, never used an authenticated session, and never communicated with OpenAI. Yet test_dogfood_chatgpt_workflow.py and evidence generation emitted evidence_class REAL_INSTALLED_PRODUCT_EXECUTION.
findings.remediation: Relabel evidence class to SIMULATED_PROVIDER. Remove prompt-specific hardcoded trajectory/math mocks from production delegation loops.

findings.title: Entire RAG subsystem is unwired and dead in production composition root
findings.description: All 10 modules in astrarun.rag (context, embeddings, indexer, models, router, skills, store, vector, worker) are unimported by AstraApplication, main, or entrypoint. The subsystem is only exercised by test_milestone3_rag_subsystem.py.

findings.title: Entire Perception and OmniParser subsystem is unwired and dead in production
findings.description: All 11 modules in astrarun.perception (capture, cdp, com, cv, grounder, input, models, ocr, router, vlm) are unimported by the production application. Production desktop automation uses astrarun.interaction.service (pywinauto/UIA) directly. OmniParser and Florence-2 visual grounding are isolated in test suites.

findings.title: ModelService, Qwen, and Spark are disconnected from resident product execution
findings.description: AstraApplication never starts or contacts ModelService, Spark (:8090), or Qwen (:8089). GoalPlanner uses CapabilitySemanticIndex (in-memory BM25/keyword index) and regex rules. DynamicToolBuilder attempts an HTTP call to Qwen if online, but defaults to hardcoded fallback script generation when offline.

findings.title: ActionGate security policy is bypassed by built-in commands and dynamic tooling
findings.description: In AstraApplication.handle_request(), built-in actions (open_application, open_url, system_info) dispatch directly to capability_registry.execute() without passing through ActionGate.evaluate(). Furthermore, DynamicToolBuilder executes generated scripts in SandboxManager relying solely on AST regex/inspection without ActionGate risk scoring.

findings.title: SandboxManager provides process containment, NOT security virtualization
findings.description: SandboxManager uses Win32 Job Objects to enforce memory limits (512MB) and kill-on-close. It does NOT use Windows AppContainer, restricted tokens, or file system filter virtualization. Generated Python scripts execute with the full security context of the logged-in user, capable of accessing user profile files, reading secrets, or opening network sockets.

findings.title: Laya worker relies on torchvision masking monkey-patch and unbundled HF weights
findings.description: laya_worker.py masks torchvision via sys.modules['torchvision'] = None to prevent DLL import crashes. The frozen PyInstaller executable bundles torch (365MB) but bundles no weights. Laya with TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 crashes at startup unless weights exist in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AstraRun\cache\huggingface.

findings.title: Hardcoded acceptance criteria and prompt special cases in agent loop
findings.description: Production code contains special cases tailored specifically to dogfood and acceptance test queries. For example, delegation loop specifically looks for 'projectile_sim.py', 'projectile_motion.py', and 'Astra Delegate Test'; dynamic tool builder falls back to a canned matplotlib 3D math script.

findings.title: Duplicate subsystems: dual memory, dual skills, dual action gates
findings.description: Parallel implementations exist across milestone boundaries: astrarun.rag.store vs astrarun.learning.memory (MemoryStore); astrarun.rag.skills vs astrarun.learning.skills (SkillRegistry); astrarun.security.action_gate vs astrarun.policy.action_gate.

findings.title: Frozen binary distribution bloat: 1.1GB containing unused runtimes
findings.description: PyInstaller dist includes _polars_runtime_32.pyd (167MB), PyTorch (365MB), and OpenCV (112MB). Polars is completely unimported in production. OpenCV is used only by unwired perception modules. PyTorch is bundled without weights.

findings.title: 1,984 vendored upstream repository files pollute the test tree
findings.description: tests/benchmarks contains full vendored copies of open_interpreter and other external repositories, skewing code metrics, test discovery, and linters.

findings.title: Browser automation lacks CDP session bridge to user's authenticated profiles
findings.description: astrarun.browser does not attach to active user browser profiles with debugging ports. It cannot authenticate or interact with live user sessions on chatgpt.com or Claude web.

findings.title: Dual telemetry collector and shadow collector create unnecessary disk I/O
findings.description: TelemetryCollector and ShadowCollector run concurrently writing parallel JSONL streams for every interaction turn.

findings.title: Silent default fallbacks in config loader mask missing configuration files
findings.description: Config loader catches all IOErrors and silently returns hardcoded defaults, masking configuration syntax errors and missing production config files.

special_findings.A_System32_Crash: Caused by MachineModel.get_instance() resolving data/machine/machine_facts.db relative to CWD. When launched with CWD C:\Windows\System32, mkdir threw WinError 5 Access is denied: 'C:\Windows\System32\data'. Resolved by anchoring to AstraPaths.user_data_dir.
special_findings.B_Relative_Paths_Audit: Found 44 relative path constructions in production code across 20 files. All 44 now anchored to AstraPaths (%LOCALAPPDATA%\AstraRun and %TEMP%\AstraRun). Tested across 6 CWDs: C:\, C:\Windows, C:\Windows\System32, Desktop, Downloads, Temp.
special_findings.C_ChatGPT_Dogfood_Truth: SIMULATED_PROVIDER. ChatGPTWebDelegate only verified browser process existence via psutil, and its _dispatch_browser_interaction() returned a hardcoded Python projectile motion script. It never launched a browser, navigated to chatgpt.com, or reached OpenAI.
special_findings.D_Dogfood_Evidence_Classification: Evidence generated by test_dogfood_chatgpt_workflow.py was marked REAL_INSTALLED_PRODUCT_EXECUTION but should strictly be classified as SIMULATED_PROVIDER or MOCK. No real physical user, browser automation, or external model participated.
special_findings.E_Simulated_vs_Real_Tests: Current test suite runs in source-tree pytest against Python classes. Acceptance tests for 3D visualization and delegation pass because DynamicToolBuilder falls back to canned matplotlib templates and ChatGPTWebDelegate returns canned scripts.
special_findings.F_Qwen_Participation: Qwen NEVER runs in resident product execution. ModelService is uncalled by AstraApplication. DynamicToolBuilder uses regex/canned templates when Qwen (:8089) is unreachable.
special_findings.G_Spark_Participation: Spark NEVER runs in resident product execution. ModelService is uncalled. GoalPlanner uses BM25 keyword matching via CapabilitySemanticIndex rather than Spark cognitive planning.
special_findings.H_Laya_Frozen_Viability: Laya worker uses torchvision monkey-patching (sys.modules['torchvision'] = None) to bypass DLL crashes. In frozen builds, PyTorch is packaged without weights; offline mode fails unless weights are manually placed in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AstraRun\cache\huggingface.
special_findings.I_OmniParser_Semantics: OmniParser (astrarun.perception.grounder) is totally unimported and disconnected from production. Desktop automation strictly uses pywinauto/UIA in astrarun.interaction.service.
special_findings.J_ChatGPT_Web_Control_Feasibility: Cannot control authenticated ChatGPT web today. No CDP remote-debugging attachment to running user browser sessions exists. Only a mock string generator exists.
special_findings.K_ActionGate_Bypasses: Built-in commands (open_application, open_url, system_info) bypass ActionGate.evaluate() entirely. DynamicToolBuilder executes generated scripts in sandbox without ActionGate risk scoring.
special_findings.L_SandboxManager_Reality: SandboxManager is PROCESS CONTAINMENT (Win32 Job Object memory limits + kill-on-close), NOT a security sandbox. Scripts execute with full host user privileges.
special_findings.M_Dead_Subsystems: astrarun.rag (10 modules), astrarun.perception (11 modules), astrarun.ai_bridge (2 modules). Completely unwired from resident application.
special_findings.N_Duplicated_Subsystems: Dual MemoryStore (rag.store vs learning.memory), Dual SkillRegistry (rag.skills vs learning.skills), Dual ActionGate (security.action_gate vs policy.action_gate).
special_findings.O_Single_Weakest_Link: The disconnect between the advertised multi-model cognitive architecture and the actual running codebase: Astra is documented as an autonomous LLM/VLM agent, but runs as a deterministic command bar with models sitting isolated in separate test harnesses.
